readerCopy.body: Growth can become compensation when another credential, promise, project, or ambitious leap starts carrying the job of proving an old doubt wrong. When Jupiter squares Chiron, expansion and sensitivity create friction, making enough feel difficult to recognize because stopping would leave the insecurity unanswered. If the next achievement is carrying the job of proving something about your worth, you may find it harder to tell when the opportunity itself is already enough. Growth is easier to judge once improving life is separated from demonstrating that an earlier limitation has no power left.
